response.justification: The candidate is a strong generalist engineer with solid web, TypeScript, and DLang experience, but lacks the core requirements for this role. His C++ experience is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 and a university thesis, far short of the mandated 5–10 years of hands-on Windows C++ development. He also has no Fixed Income, capital markets, or investment banking domain expertise, and no evidence of deep SQL Server/Oracle work.
strengths: Broad, long-tenured software engineering career with strong fundamentals (TDD, CI/CD, low-latency systems)
Some low-level/performance experience via DLang and past C/C++ work at National Instruments
Excellent communication skills demonstrated through workshops, talks, and open-source contributions
concerns: Only ~7 months of professional C++ experience, and none since 2015 — well below the 5–10 year requirement
No Fixed Income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience (RIDE Capital was retail investment fintech, not capital markets)
No demonstrated SQL Server/Oracle or Windows-platform development depth; recent work is entirely web/TypeScript

key_factors.factor: No capital markets / fixed income domain knowledge
Strong general engineering fundamentals and CI/CD experience
